correctness.rationale: The Foata fixed-point characterizations are necessary and sufficient; separating on extremal fixed point gives two exact cycle enumerations, one via slots enforcing no larger singleton, the other via a unique descending high-letter cycle. The rencontres transform and the factorial-moment identity both reduce to D(z)+z/(1-z-z^2) D(z/(1-z-z^2)). Boundary cases n=0, no fixed points, b=0 are covered. The standalone verifier explicitly runs two direct avoidance tests through n=7, checks larger n=8 by Foata patterns, and matches integer coefficient formulas through n=18. Finite checks supplement rather than replace proof.

value.rationale: Resolves a precise recently posed Wilf-equivalence problem for natural short arrow patterns. The uniform factorial-moment bridge explains why separately enumerated classes agree and gives the same formal generating function at all n.
